messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SmartRouting fallback has routed requests that should have been pinned to EU to us-east-1. Detected 12 cross-region sessions (estimated window ~18m). Root trigger: fallback-policy v2.3.4 rollout. start_ts=1778001216
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: INC-4521 opened, paging rotations started. Notifying SRE(+sec) and oncall.
Alice (Oncall): Oncall Alice here. I acknowledge, joining. Can someone paste the rollout diff?
Ben - SRE: I see the rollout. rolling out v2.3.4 at 1778001200 to routing service fleet. Minimal change but residency fallback key accidentally set to 'closest' during templating.
Ben - SRE: Config diff (from rollout job):
```
- residency_fallback: strict
+ residency_fallback: closest
```
Ben - SRE: That change causes the routing policy to prefer lowest-latency region for fallbacks instead of enforcing tenant residency. Canary gating didn't catch it because test tenants are global.
Claire (Security): How many customers impacted and what data? GDPR concerns?
Ben - SRE: Affected sessions: cust-eu-102, cust-eu-204, cust-eu-309 — about 12 sessions total. Payloads were user prompts + request metadata. No attachments. Retention policy still EU for stored objects but processing occurred in us-east-1 for the fallback calls.
Dan (Product): Product here — we need a customer-facing timeline and recommended wording. Legal + Security please advise.
Alice (Oncall): Mitigation plan (quick):
  1) Disable automatic residency fallback globally (pause fallback_policy execution).
  2) Roll back fallback-policy to v2.3.3 immediately.
  3) Force-route affected tenant traffic to EU model variant (eu-gpt-small-quant) until we validate.
  4) Run audit of cross-region hits and produce list of affected request ids for Legal.
Ben - SRE: Executing now. Commands:
```bash
# pause fallback execution
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/configs/fallback-policy/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" -d '{}'
# rollback to previous stable
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/configs/fallback-policy/rollback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" -d '{"target_version":"v2.3.3"}'
# enforce per-tenant routing to eu-west-1
./rctl set-routing --scope=tenant --tenant=cust-eu-* --policy=enforce-residency --region=eu-west-1
```
Ben - SRE: Pause request succeeded @1778001305. Rollback started @1778001312. Per-tenant routing applied @1778001330.
Alice (Oncall): Verified: controlplane shows fallback paused, routing policies at 100% enforce-residency for affected tenants. Monitoring — no new cross-region hits in last 2m. :white_check_mark:
Ben - SRE: Network logs: last us-east-1 outbound for those tenant IDs at 1778001348. Count=12.
Claire (Security): Security here. This is a data residency violation; treat as P1. No signs of external exfiltration yet, but we will:
  - open internal incident report (IR-2026-03-14-01)
  - notify DPO and Legal to assess notification requirements under GDPR
  - prepare initial draft for customers (short, factual, next steps)
Claire (Security): Also need audit of logs + ephemeral KV caches, confirm no async replications touched non-EU storage.
Dan (Product): Assigning Product liaison to help with customer comms. I'll coordinate wording with Legal.
Legal: Legal here, standing by. We'll need the list of request IDs, timestamps, and confirmation of what was stored vs transient processing. We will advise on whether disclosure is required.
Alice (Oncall): Oncall handoff note: I'm oncall for the next 30m, then handing to Eve. Eve — I'll patch runbook and handover in 20m.
Eve (Oncall): Acknowledged — I will take over at 1778002000.
PagerDuty: Escalation: SecEng lead and SRE lead notified. Incident severity set to P1 (data residency).
Ben - SRE: Post-rollback checks: routing config diff shows residency_fallback: strict restored. Canary tests updated to include residency enforcement. Added unit test to templating script to fail if residency key is changed without explicit opt-in.
Ben - SRE: Added metric to alert on any cross-region routing for tenants with residency tag: metric name=router.cross_region.count, threshold>0 for EU-tagged tenants -> page oncall.
Claire (Security): We'll run forensic check on model KV caches and short-lived artifacts. Results due in 4 hours.
Alice (Oncall): Immediate customer impact summary for Ops: 3 EU tenants saw processing in us-east-1 for up to 18m. Approx 12 sessions, estimated 1.2k tokens total. No evidence of long-term storage outside EU.
Dan (Product): Action items logged: (1) Improve rollout gating for routing policies, (2) Add residency unit tests in CI, (3) Add automated cross-region alert, (4) Customer communication playbook update. Owner: Ben (SRE) for 1&2, Claire (Security) for 3&4 with Legal.
Ben - SRE: I've created a follow-up ticket ENG-8342 (rollback/root-cause/fix) and linked to IR-2026-03-14-01.
Alice (Oncall): Thanks team. I'll hand off to Eve in 20. Eve — any questions before I go?
Eve (Oncall): No questions. Please include the curl commands and the list of affected request ids in the handover note. I'll monitor the alert and the cross-region metric.
Claire (Security): We'll coordinate customer notification draft with Legal and Product; aiming for initial outreach if Legal advises disclosure is needed.
Ben - SRE: Closing on immediate mitigation. Rollback verified. Scheduling postmortem and permanent guardrails.
Alice (Oncall): Incident contained. Moving to incident tracking. Postmortem owner Ben. :eyes: :white_check_mark:
